caption: The drawing depicts three views of a small, decorative oval object, likely a box or case. The top view at the upper center shows a blue scalloped-edge lid with a painted scene and a border of white dots. Within the scene, a figure in light-colored clothing sits next to an object, possibly a pedestal or table, holding a leafy branch, and beside them is a rectangular item with stripes in red, white, and blue; above the figure, the words "Peace and Love" are written. The background includes green and brown areas, possibly representing land and sky. The middle-left view shows the inside of the box, featuring a plain blue interior bordered by a yellowish-gold edge. The rightmost view is a side profile of the closed box, highlighting the thickness, blue scalloped lid, and a narrow golden band separating the top and bottom halves. Below the objects, a scale marked in inches is drawn and labeled "Scale of Inches." The composition is arranged on a plain, beige background with annotated text in the lower center and a faint signature at the bottom right corner.
title: Snuff Box
